summaryLines: Independent sensitivity oracle: meta 8.5-0, metafor 5.2-1, metasens 1.5-3.
Refusals pass only when both implementations refuse for the same reason.
Effective rendered geometry checked against rendered axis ticks within 0.02 CSS px; text character positions included.
Rendered forest/funnel coordinates inverted to effect/SE units: 1e-9 relative tolerance with unit floor.
Closed-form tolerance 1e-9 relative; selection parameters/logLik 1e-6 and SE/CI 1e-4.
